article.story: No. 12 BYU (8-2) at Kansas (4-6), Nov. 21 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: BYU by 5.5. Against the spread: BYU 7-3, Kansas 2-6-1. How to watch: ABC Key stats BYU Offense Overall: 388.6 yards per game (61st in FBS) Passing: 217.5 yards per game (78th) Rushing: 171.1 yards per game (50th) Scoring: 30.7 points per game (45th) BYU Defense Overall: 295.8 yards per game (20th in FBS) Passing: 195.5 yards per game (42nd) Rushing: 100.3 yards per game (16th) Scoring: 18.5 points per game (20th) Kansas Offense Overall: 442.2 yards per game (25th in FBS) Passing: 231.4 yards per game (60th) Rushing: 210.8 yards per game (16th) Scoring: 30.2 points per game (49th) Kansas Defense Overall: 335.6 yards per game (39th in FBS) Passing: 190.1 yards per game (35th) Rushing: 145.5 yards per game (76th) Scoring: 23.7 points per game (62nd) BYU is 9th in FBS in third down percentage, converting 50.4% of the time. Kansas ranks 112th in the FBS with a -5 turnover margin. Kansas ranks 24th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 31:51. Team leaders BYU Passing: Bear Bachmeier, 2,126 yards, 14 TDs, 8 INTs, 62.3 completion percentage Rushing: Bachmeier, 449 yards on 103 carries, 10 TDs Receiving: Legend Glasker, 706 yards on 42 catches, 5 TDs Kansas Passing: Isaiah Marshall, 1,868 yards, 11 TDs, 8 INTs, 57.3 completion percentage Rushing: Marshall, 692 yards on 121 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Nik McMillan, 541 yards on 37 catches, 5 TDs Last game BYU beat Baylor 28-7 on Nov. 14. Bachmeier led BYU with 104 yards on 14-of-24 passing (58.3%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 15 times for 54 yards and three rushing touchdowns. L.J. Martin had 49 rushing yards on six carries. Walker Lyons had three receptions for 49 yards. Kansas beat West Virginia 37-14 on Nov. 14. Marshall led Kansas with 152 yards on 15-of-18 passing (83.3%) for no touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 19 times for 164 yards and one rushing touchdown. Chase Belcher had 58 rushing yards on 14 carries and two touchdowns, adding one reception for 28 yards. McMillan had six receptions for 44 yards. Next game BYU hosts Cincinnati on Nov. 28. Kansas plays at Oklahoma State on Nov. 28.
